main_text.l: Hæc Tu; sed confuse nimis complures quæstiones &
perturbatè misces; quas Nos, methodi gratiâ, in sua
genera dispertiemus: I. De Iudice vestro agemus:
II. De Luthero Reo, & iudicato: III. De Causa ipsa:
IV. De Prophetia illa Ab Aquilone; in qua non modò
omnes Anglos, & præcipuè serenissimum Magnæ Britanniæ Re-
gem satis insulsè subsannas: verùm etiam luculentissimis
sacræ Scripturæ verbis caliginem offundis, & ad sensum
tuum planè abuteris. Et quoniam hæc omnia abs Te eo
animo dicuntur, ut Principes aduersus Lutheri doctrinam
instiges, propterea, postremo in loco, orthodoxum iu-
dicium Lutheri aduersus Papistas, de nequiter violata Eo-
rum, erga Principes, obedientia attexemus.
I. ANIMADVERSIO.

page.notes: The text at the top is set in italic. The lines near the top of the page are in italic type, including "rus emersit". The printed "Non" in the note is marked "a" in the text. The catchword "quod" and signature "Q" are at the foot. The third paragraph ends mid-sentence with the catchword "quod". Long s is transcribed as s, and the printed spelling is kept, for example "confuse", "misces", "Eorum", "ficut", "constitutum".
